issues.evidence: 2 ground-truth curves (prop_x=Temperature/K, prop_y=Electrical resistivity/ohm*m), n=37/38 points, x=2.9-300.0K matches the inset's 0-300K axis. y max 0.0128-0.0151 ohm*m sits just below the inset's 10^-2 top gridline, decreasing toward ~10^-3 at high T -- matches the inset's log-y axis and visible curve shape exactly. Note: both GT curves include a small negative-value outlier near the y-axis origin (-0.00045 and -0.00016 ohm*m respectively) which is physically implausible for resistivity and likely digitization/fitting noise at the axis edge -- flagged here rather than silently dropped, does not affect the overall shape match. Cropped tightly to the inset box (x=[310,733] y=[195,480] on the parent embedded image, 733x1072px) to avoid mixing with the main panel's S-vs-T curves (same black/red color scheme, would otherwise contaminate a naive-cv-style pixel extractor).

4 ground-truth curves (prop_x=Temperature/K, prop_y=Electrical conductivity/ohm^(-1)*m^(-1)). x-values ~223-399K match the chart's printed x-axis range. 3 of 4 curves have y-values in 61130-103454 ohm^-1*m^-1, consistent with the chart's printed y-axis 'Electrical conductivity sigma, ohm^-1 cm^-1' spanning ~250-1250 after unit conversion (ohm^-1 cm^-1 * 100 = ohm^-1 m^-1). One of the 4 curves has an outlier range (662-1028 ohm^-1*m^-1, ~2 orders of magnitude below the other three) not yet independently reconciled against the chart -- flagged here for a future re-check rather than silently dropped. 5 ground-truth curves (prop_x=Inverse temperature/K^-1, prop_y=log(Electrical conductivity)/S*m^-1) -- but all 5 curves have x-range exactly (0.0, 0.0), i.e. every x-value collapsed to zero. This is a ground-truth data quality defect (not a pairing/image problem): the underlying digitized data for this figure is unusable regardless of which of the 53 candidate images it might correspond to. Rejected on GT-quality grounds before any image was checked, per the design's 'GT quality check' step of the verification procedure.
